Package com.im.njams.sdk.settings

Class Settings

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.im.njams.sdk.settings.Settings
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    ClientSettings, Iterable<Map.Entry<String,​String>>
    @Deprecated
public class Settings
extends Object
implements ClientSettings
    Deprecated.
    This class is preserved only as a legacy implementation of ClientSettings for backwards compatibility with existing client code. The SDK itself no longer uses it internally — all internal settings handling now goes through the ClientSettings and ReadOnlyClientSettings interfaces. Obtain settings instances via one of the factory methods on those interfaces: ClientSettings.from(java.util.Map), ClientSettings.from(java.util.Properties), ClientSettings.fromSystemProperties(java.util.function.Predicate), or ReadOnlyClientSettings.fromEnvironment(java.util.function.Predicate) for a read-only environment-backed view.
    The settings contains settings needed for Njams

    All static final names of settings are moved to @NjamsSettings Please only use them and not the deprecated ones from here-

        public String getPropertyWithDeprecationWarning​(String expectedKey,

                                                String deprecatedKey)

        Same as getProperty(String, String) if the expectedKey exists. If not, the deprecatedKey is tried and if found, a deprecation warning is logged for that key and the value is returned. Only if the deprecatedKey was also not found, the default value is returned.

        Returns:

      • getBool

        public default boolean getBool​(String key,
                               boolean defaultValue)
        Returns the value for the given key parsed as a boolean. Only the case-insensitive literals "true" and "false" are accepted. If no value is registered the given default is returned. If the registered value is anything else, a warning is logged and the default is returned.
        Parameters:
        key - the key to look up
        defaultValue - the value to return when the key is missing or the value is not a valid boolean
        Returns:
        the parsed boolean or defaultValue on missing/invalid input

      • getIntWithDeprecationWarning

        public default int getIntWithDeprecationWarning​(String expectedKey,
                                                int defaultValue,
                                                String deprecatedKey)
        Same as getInt(String, int) with deprecated-key fallback. The deprecated key is tried only if expectedKey is not present; a deprecation warning is logged when the fallback is used. If neither key is present (or both yield unparseable values), the default is returned.
        Parameters:
        expectedKey - the expected (current) key
        defaultValue - the value to return when neither key is present or both values are invalid
        deprecatedKey - deprecated key to try if the expected key does not exist
        Returns:
        the parsed integer or defaultValue

      • getPropertyWithAlternativeKey

        public default String getPropertyWithAlternativeKey​(String expectedKey,
                                                    String defaultValue,
                                                    String alternativeKey)
        Returns the value for expectedKey if present. Otherwise, if alternativeKey is present, its value is returned. If neither key is present, defaultValue is returned.

        Unlike getPropertyWithDeprecationWarning(String, String, String), no warning is logged: both keys are equally valid, permanent spellings of the same setting, and neither is deprecated. This is intended for settings whose primary key also happens to be a prefix of other settings keys, which makes the primary key impossible to express in some hierarchical configuration formats (e.g. YAML); the alternative key gives such sources a collision-free way to set the same value.

        Parameters:
        expectedKey - the primary key
        defaultValue - the value to return when neither key is present
        alternativeKey - an equally valid alternative key to try if expectedKey is not present
        Returns:
        the resolved value, or defaultValue if neither key is present
